adar.description: Has carried stone since the first morning. Says little, always turns up.

neriah.description: Came to measure the valley's ruins. Stayed because the place was worth remaking.

base_adar.description: Broad in the shoulders and short in the trunk, from lifting stone all day.

base_neriah.description: Tall and narrow, from crossing the valley end to end on foot.

hair_short_crop.description: Cut close, the way that stays out of a working day.

hair_tied_back.description: Combed back and tied at the nape, in a low ponytail.

hair_side_braid.description: Tied to one side, so the wind does not decide for you.

hair_loose_waves.description: Worn loose, like someone who has only just arrived.

hair_shaved_band.description: Shaved at the sides, a strip of cloth holding the rest.

hair_headscarf.description: Knotted over the top: midday sun, dust all day long.

hair_work_bun.description: Pinned high and tight, clear of rope, scaffold and fire.

outfit_carrier_tunic.description: Short sleeves and the hem tied at the waist, the way stone gets carried.

outfit_surveyor_wrap.description: Cloth crossed at the chest and tied at the waist, with room for line and plumb.

outfit_clay_tunic.description: Heavy cloth the colour of the ground here. It stains and nobody notices.

outfit_terracotta_tunic.description: Lighter and cooler, good for walking the whole valley.

outfit_expedition_gear.description: Hood, tied sleeves and pockets: made for days away from the wall.

outfit_work_apron.description: Reinforced leather across chest and thighs, for carrying stone without cuts.

outfit_travel_cloak.description: Falls over both shoulders and closes the hood. People from far away arrive in these.

outfit_valley_mantle.description: Falls from the back alone: the shoulder stays clear, and you are known from a distance.

outfit_watch_wool.description: Heavy wool with no shape to it, for a whole night standing still.

acc_rope_coil.description: Coiled on the right shoulder, always ready. It is how people pick you out.

acc_map_tube.description: Slung across the back, the whole valley drawn inside it.

acc_tool_bag.description: At the belt, with what breaks stone and what lifts it.

acc_ring_belt.description: Iron rings at the front of the belt, to tie rope to anything.

acc_bead_bracelet.description: Clay beads on a cord, on the right wrist. Someone in the valley made it.

acc_old_seal.description: Found in the foundation, a name cut into it that nobody here can read.

acc_watch_horn.description: Slung on the left shoulder. Wherever it sounds, that is where everyone runs.

acc_plumb_line.description: Lead on a cord at the belt. Calls a course out before the one above proves it.

acc_gate_key.description: Bent iron on a leather cord, at the neck. It fits one door, and the door exists now.
